python3 << 'PY'
import re, pathlib
root = pathlib.Path("/home/mohammad-hashim/AI-learnings/Assesment")
prompts_dir = root / "prompts"
history_dir = root / ".specstory" / "history"
history_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

entries = []
for path in sorted(prompts_dir.glob("[0-9][0-9]-*.md")):
    text = path.read_text()
    title_m = re.search(r"^#\s+(.+)$", text, re.M)
    title = title_m.group(1).strip() if title_m else path.stem
    # Extract fenced prompt under "## Prompt"
    m = re.search(r"## Prompt \(copy into Cursor\)\s*\n+```\n(.*?)```", text, re.S)
    body = m.group(1).strip() if m else "(see source prompt file)"
    date = "2026-09-22"
    hist_name = f"{date}_{path.stem}.md"
    hist_path = history_dir / hist_name
    content = f"""# {title}

- **Date:** {date}
- **Tool:** Cursor
- **Source prompt pack:** `prompts/{path.name}`
- **Index:** `docs/prompt-history.md`

> Security: do not include secrets, tokens, API keys, passwords, or `.env` contents in prompt history.

## Prompt

```
{body}
```
"""
    hist_path.write_text(content)
    entries.append({
        "date": date,
        "title": title,
        "tool": "Cursor",
        "source": f"prompts/{path.name}",
        "history": f".specstory/history/{hist_name}",
    })
    print(f"Wrote {hist_path.name}")

print(f"Total: {len(entries)}")
